items.title: pingdotgg/t3code
items.author: pingdotgg
items.summary_zh: T3 Code 是 pingdotgg 开源的 agent 控制面板，提供 iOS、Android、Web 和 Electron 桌面端，可远程操控本机已登录的 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 等 agent。作者称 Codex 桌面端、Conductor、Claude Desktop 都没达到自己的标准才动手自建，代码开放、可 fork 改造。适合订阅了多个编码 agent、想用手机接管本机会话的开发者。
items.summary_en: T3 Code is an open-source control surface from pingdotgg for the coding agents already installed and authenticated on your machine, shipping as iOS, Android, web and Electron desktop clients. It drives Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity and fx on your existing subscriptions. The authors say Codex's desktop app, Conductor, Claude Desktop and Cursor Glass didn't meet their bar, so the code stays forkable. Useful for developers juggling several agent subscriptions who want remote control.

items.title: AI+垂类Agent：任务跑得久、工具用得熟，撑不起Agent公司长期竞争力｜贝联珠贯创始人兼CEO 毕玄分享
items.summary_zh: 贝联珠贯创始人兼 CEO、前阿里巴巴集团研究员毕玄在 1024 模力工场 AI 社区日上，以企业 IT 运维助手 SREAgent 为例谈垂类 Agent 的竞争力。他认为跑长任务、熟练调用通用工具这类优势会随大模型进步被抹平，壁垒在于接入各家不同的监控日志数据、建立能随业务自我演进的领域模型；SREAgent 3.0 已支持用自然语言生成 Skill，降低数据接入门槛。
items.summary_en: At the 1024 ModelWorks AI Community Day, Bi Xuan, founder and CEO of Beilian Zhuguan, used his team's SREAgent — an AI assistant that reads monitoring data and logs to help enterprises troubleshoot IT systems — to argue that vertical agents cannot win on long-running tasks or fluent tool use, since models are absorbing those abilities. The durable moat, he says, is wiring up each customer's messy monitoring and log sources and building domain models that keep evolving with the business. SREAgent 3.0 lets customers generate Skills from natural-language requests.

items.summary_en: Cisco president and chief product officer Jeetu Patel handed a 27-year-old, Padmanabhan Krishnamurthy — a former AI startup CEO whose company Cisco acquired — the job of rewriting 98% of Cisco's legacy code with just two people, an unlimited AI token budget and a 24-month target that starts with a four-week validation. Fortune reported the story on October 30; Cisco has not disclosed progress, scope or tooling. The real question is how AI coding reshapes engineering orgs at large enterprises.

items.title: EmbeddingGemma 2：Google 把五种模态塞进同一个向量空间
items.summary_zh: Google 发布 EmbeddingGemma 2，这是基于 Gemma 4、以 Apache 2.0 许可发布的开放权重多模态嵌入模型，把文本、代码、图像、视频和音频放进同一个 768 维向量空间，可按需只加载部分编码器，参数量从 2.7 亿到 7.4 亿，并针对设备端部署做过优化。它支持 MRL 截断：100 万个 768 维向量约需 1.5GB 内存，截到 128 维只需 250MB，代价是图像、视频和语音检索质量降到约 75%。适合做端侧搜索、RAG 与跨媒体检索的开发者。
items.summary_en: Google released EmbeddingGemma 2, an Apache 2.0 open-weight multimodal embedding model built on Gemma 4 that maps text, code, images, video and audio into a single 768-dimensional space, letting developers load only the encoders they need, with parameter counts from 270M to 740M and tuning for on-device deployment. Matryoshka truncation cuts a million 768-dim vectors from about 1.5GB to 250MB at 128 dimensions, though image, video and audio retrieval quality falls to roughly 75%. Aimed at local search, RAG and cross-media retrieval.

items.title: AI+社区：「模力工场」连接AI供需，补上信任缺口｜极客邦科技创始人兼CEO 霍太稳分享
items.summary_zh: 极客邦科技创始人兼 CEO 霍太稳在 1024 模力工场·AI 社区日上介绍「模力工场」：用 AI 估算项目所需的时间和预算，按技术团队过往的交付表现推荐合作方，合作后再跟进交付、评估结果，想补上企业找不到靠谱团队、团队又担心收不到钱之间的信任缺口。他同时宣布极客邦科技南方总部与 TGO 鲲鹏会全球总部落户杭州，并提到企业需求正从几天培训转向让服务方带团队做出可用的智能体与 Skill。
items.summary_en: At the 1024 模力工场 AI community day, 极客邦科技 founder and CEO 霍太稳 introduced 模力工场, a platform that uses AI to estimate a project's time and budget, recommend delivery teams based on their past performance, and then track delivery and evaluate results — targeting the trust gap between companies that can't find reliable teams and teams that fear not getting paid. He also announced that 极客邦's southern headquarters and TGO's global headquarters are settling in Hangzhou, and noted enterprises now want vendors to build working agents and Skills with their teams rather than sit through multi-day training.

items.title: [分享创造] 做了一个网页旁的画布：收藏带来源，圈出细节交给 Codex / Claude Code
items.summary_zh: Galta 是作者开源的网页侧边无限画布，浏览时收进来的图片会带上网页来源，你可以在同一块画布上写两笔、圈出某个细节，再交给 Codex 或 Claude Code 接着做。项目已有公开测试版，作者在找正在整理视觉参考、做灵感板的人试用；安装需 Chrome 141+ 或 Dia，接原生 Agent 还要 Apple 芯片 Mac 和 macOS 15 以上。
items.summary_en: Galta is an open-source infinite canvas that sits beside the browser: images you collect arrive with their web source, and you can sketch on the same canvas, then point Codex or Claude Code at one detail to continue. A public beta is installable, and the author is recruiting people who build visual reference boards to try it. Install needs Chrome 141+ or Dia; native agent connection also requires an Apple-silicon Mac on macOS 15 or newer.

The author pitched it inside a thread about reverse-engineering Sogou's IME and asked for stars. It's relevant to developers who want to tinker with a local input method or train their own model.

items.title: 当AI从“会想”走向“会干”——腾讯云与英特尔共筑Agentic AI执行新底座
items.summary_zh: 腾讯云与英特尔合作搭建 Agentic AI 执行底座：Agent 按“规划—推理—行动—反馈”循环运行，一次请求会展开成大量工具调用，CPU 不再只是 GPU 的配套。文中点出突发算力下如何保留任务现场、内存先于核心数成为密度瓶颈这两大问题，对应方案是腾讯云 Cube Sandbox 的计算与状态弹性。
items.summary_en: Tencent Cloud and Intel outline a joint infrastructure stack for agentic AI, where a request runs through a plan-reason-act-feedback loop and fans out into many tool and code calls, so the CPU is no longer merely a companion to the GPU. Two problems are framed: keeping task state alive across bursty workloads, and memory capacity, not core count, capping how many agents a node can host. Tencent Cloud's Cube Sandbox answers with compute and state elasticity, including pause, resume and snapshots.

items.title: .NET 11 第 2 个候选版本发布，带来生产环境部署许可以及针对库、F#、MAUI 和 WinForms 的更新
items.summary_zh: 微软发布 .NET 11 第 2 个候选版本，附带可用于生产环境部署的许可，支持 Visual Studio 2026 Insiders 以及安装了 C# Dev Kit 的 VS Code。更新覆盖库、运行时、SDK、NuGet、F#、ASP.NET Core、MAUI 和 WinForms，但没有引入新的 C# 语言特性；运行时偏重可靠性，并在 iOS 与 tvOS 上默认关闭建议性文件锁定，避免后台应用被系统终止。
items.summary_en: Microsoft shipped .NET 11 RC2, which carries a go-live license for production deployment and is supported in Visual Studio 2026 Insiders and VS Code with the C# Dev Kit. Updates span libraries, runtime, SDK, NuGet, F#, ASP.NET Core, MAUI and WinForms, but add no new C# language features. The runtime emphasizes reliability, with a breaking change that disables advisory file locking by default on iOS and tvOS so backgrounded apps don't get killed.

items.summary_en: OffRails is an uncensored AI service promoted on V2EX: Qwen-based uncensored chat plus image generation and editing, no chat logs stored, and no KYC, email or credit card needed. API usage earns RAIL tokens, and the team says 90% of distributable profit goes into a Fare vault that staked RAIL holders share by amount and duration. items.title: 终于不是 AI 了：Lambda 直接运行 Express，API Gateway 还需要吗？
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊云科技推出 Lambda Web Functions，让 Express、Hono、Fastify、Next.js 等 Node.js 框架写的标准 HTTP 服务器直接用一条命令部署到 Lambda，无需适配层，支持并发请求和流式响应，计费按活跃 CPU 时间而非等待下游服务的空转时间。原有的 Lambda 函数改称 Lambda Event Functions，无需改动；已预热的执行环境可同时处理多个请求，冷启动因此明显减少。目前仅支持 Node.js，需要自定义域名、边缘缓存或 AWS WAF 时要在前面挂 CloudFront。想省掉 API Gateway 那层胶水代码的 Web 与 API 开发者值得一试。
items.summary_en: AWS launched Lambda Web Functions, which runs a standard Node.js HTTP server built with Express, Hono, Fastify or Next.js directly on Lambda with a single deploy command and no adapter layer. It supports concurrent requests and streaming responses, and bills on active CPU time rather than time spent waiting on downstream services. Existing functions are now called Lambda Event Functions and need no changes, while a warmed execution environment handles multiple requests at once to cut cold starts. It is Node.js only for now, and custom domains or AWS WAF still require CloudFront in front.

items.title: [分享创造] 把 DeepSeek 的 Super-agent 思路做成一个人的桌面助手： AnyModelBot，首个开箱即用的 DeepSeek Super Agent
items.summary_zh: AnyModelBot 是把 DeepSeek 开源的 dsh-superagent 原型思路落到个人桌面上的开源助手，主打后台任务、定时规则和集中处理待你确认事项三类能力，并对推送做了限制（只推结果、决定和失败，默认 22:00–08:00 免打扰，任务有预算上限）。它本身还是个完整机器人：一个账号可切换 GPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Kimi 等 70+ 模型，能在微信和飞书里用，也能读写文件、沙箱执行命令和操作电脑，权限分三档并带审批卡片。本地优先、MIT 开源，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux/Docker，目前版本 v0.1.x，属独立项目，与 DeepSeek 官方无关。
items.summary_en: AnyModelBot is an open-source desktop assistant that turns DeepSeek's dsh-superagent prototype into something an individual can install and use, built around background tasks, scheduled rules and a single inbox for things awaiting your approval, with notifications limited to results, decisions and failures plus a default 22:00–08:00 quiet window and per-task budgets. It is also a full chatbot: one account switches among 70+ models including GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM, works inside WeChat and Feishu, and can read and write files, run sandboxed commands and control your desktop under three permission tiers with approval cards. Local-first and MIT licensed, it runs on Windows, macOS, Linux and Docker; at v0.1.x it is an independent project unrelated to DeepSeek officially.

items.title: AI 编程导师挑战低端 Android 手机！不用服务器，Python 和 SQL 直接在浏览器里运行

items.summary_en: Efiwe is a coding-education platform built for low-end phones and flaky networks: a PWA plus WebAssembly lets students run Python, SQL, JavaScript and HTML in the mobile browser, and after the first load it works offline without further data use. The author built it after only 6 of 80 students at his training school graduated, and chose PWA over a native app because of install data cost, Service Worker update speed and one runtime covering several languages. It now serves 22,000+ learners in 160 countries, with school pilots in Lagos and Ogun states and Uttarakhand, and the write-up focuses on storage quotas, cold starts and failure paths.

items.title: GitHub Actions Runner Controller 0.15.0 致力于实现大规模场景下的可靠性

items.summary_en: GitHub shipped Actions Runner Controller 0.15.0 on October 1. The Kubernetes operator, which creates and deletes self-hosted Actions runners on demand, now issues patch requests instead of full updates, folds runner state aggregation into EphemeralRunnerSet and AutoscalingRunnerSet metrics, filters incoming events, and exposes listener rate limits plus a max-concurrent-reconciles flag. For platform teams running ARC as shared CI infrastructure at scale, that means less API traffic and fewer wasted reconciles, in-place patch upgrades, and a configurable terminationGracePeriodSeconds for predictable shutdowns.
